name: 12 in F-style bar clamp
notes: Rig: jaw (slide +X along the bar, 0...0.3 m), screw (slide -X, final clamping travel), handle (hinge about the screw axis, 0...360). Lies on its side, bar along X, jaws toward +Z.
parts: zinc-plated steel bar 19 x 5.5 mm with serrated back edge
fixed cast jaw riveted to the bar end
sliding cast jaw arm with collar around the bar
swivel pad on a ball end
turned wooden handle with steel ferrule
end stop pin at the bar tail
style: Generic medium-duty 12 in F-clamp: red enamel castings, plated bar, beech handle, used: chipped paint, dried glue on the bar.
summary: 12 in F-style bar clamp: serrated plated steel bar, red cast fixed and sliding jaws, threaded screw with swivel pad, beech handle, soft jaw pads.
